name: assessments_post_comment
description: Post a comment on a capability × level of an assessment (optionally as a reply). Pass evidence_id to comment on that evidence item's linkage at the cell instead — the discussion of the feedback's relevance and valence there. `body` is Markdown: links, **bold**, _italic_, lists and `code` render, a bare URL becomes a link, typed HTML shows as text and images render as links.
